source: MR Living Capital, Three Emirates Comparison, 20 May 2026; qualitative editorial thesis

sections.title: Market function
sections.body: Use Dubai when the allocation requires a deep buyer pool, established transaction infrastructure and a comparatively clear exit audience. Judge each asset by verified activity rather than the strength of the city narrative.
sections.farsi: نقش دبی در سبد سرمایه‌گذاری، نقدشوندگی و دسترسی به خریداران بین‌المللی است.

sections.title: Demand drivers
sections.body: Test the depth and diversity of real demand for the specific district and unit. Separate end-user needs from investor momentum and identify who is likely to rent or buy the asset after the current owner.
sections.farsi: تقاضای واقعی هر منطقه و هر واحد باید جدا از هیجان بازار سنجیده شود.

sections.title: Connectivity
sections.body: Measure operational access, daily journey times and delivered infrastructure. Treat announced connections as future scenarios until their funding, construction and opening are independently verified.
sections.farsi: دسترسی عملیاتی و زمان واقعی سفر از وعده‌های آینده مهم‌تر است.

sections.title: Supply
sections.body: Compare competing ready stock with realistic future completions at district and unit-type level. A liquid city can still contain an oversupplied micro-market, so entry price must reflect the alternatives available to the next buyer.
sections.farsi: عرضه باید در سطح منطقه و نوع واحد سنجیده شود، نه فقط در سطح شهر.

sections.title: Risks
sections.body: The principal risks are paying a liquidity premium without receiving liquidity at asset level, overestimating net income and underestimating competing supply. Pressure-test service costs, resale time and the exit buyer pool.
sections.farsi: هزینه‌های خدمات، مدت فروش مجدد و عمق تقاضا باید با دقت ارزیابی شوند.

sections.title: Investor fit
sections.body: Best aligned with investors who value exit optionality, a broad buyer audience and an established market process. Less aligned with strategies whose return case depends only on a high headline yield.
sections.farsi: این مسیر برای سرمایه‌گذاری مناسب است که گزینه خروج و عمق بازار را در اولویت می‌گذارد.

sections.title: Verdict
sections.body: Dubai can serve as the liquidity component of a UAE allocation. The city thesis is not sufficient: the district, unit, net economics and realistic exit must each survive independent review. This is general market intelligence, not personalised financial advice.
sections.farsi: دبی می‌تواند جزء نقدشونده یک سبد باشد؛ تصمیم نهایی به واحد و خروج واقعی بستگی دارد.
